findings.description: The Lambda environment embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key directly in Terraform. Environment variables and Terraform state can expose these credentials to operators or any principal able to read the function configuration, enabling unauthorized AWS API access if the keys are active.
The function uses the end-of-life nodejs12.x runtime. Unsupported runtimes no longer receive security patches, increasing exposure to known runtime vulnerabilities.
